fields.name: regular_amount
docs: regular native (USDC) amount which has been deposited across
all protocols (including the pool token account) which has yet
to be deposited

fields.name: protected_amount
docs: protcted native (USDC) amount which has been deposited across
all protocols (including the pool token account) which has yet
to be deposited

fields.name: total_liquidity
docs: total liquidity, including pending fees and withdrawals

fields.name: pending_withdrawals
docs: pending withdrawals (for regular deposits) are removed
kept in the pool, while the lpTokens are burned, and the circulating
supply is removed from the protection / fees calculations

fields.name: accumulated_referral_fees
docs: total referral rewards, including unclaimed

fields.name: reserved3
docs: @deprecated

fields.name: balance_native
docs: total deposited balance in native (USDC) value

fields.name: refresh_last_ts
docs: refresh last timestamp

fields.name: accrued_amount
docs: the pending amount of interest which has been accrued
since last refresh, before it is moved to amount and
before it has been moved to the total amount

fields.name: hash_operations
docs: Hash of important accounts for deposit/withdraw

fields.name: hash_refresh
docs: Hash of important accounts for refresh tvl

fields.name: native_amount
docs: native (USDC) requested amount, potentially overridden by withdrawal_all
to account for dust that is continuously accruing

fields.name: decimals
docs: regular/protected mint decimals

fields.name: protected_bump
docs: mint bumps

fields.name: security_flag
docs: In the event of a security incident, this flag will be
flipped and most of the instructions will be frozen while
manual reconciliation can occur

fields.name: protected_interest_share_bps
docs: % protected interest that goes to regular pool

fields.name: coverage_float_bps
docs: A multiplying factor that reduces the coverage ratio checked when doing a PUSD deposit,
ensuring some space is always available for LUSD withdraw when approaching coverage ratio
default = 90%

fields.name: regular_total_supply
